description: Job Title: Project Controls Analyst Job Description We are seeking a Project Controls Analyst to support capital projects and turnaround activities by consolidating project cost data from multiple sources into accurate, standardized, and actionable reports. This individual will work closely with project managers, cost engineers, planners, schedulers, and other stakeholders to improve the flow of project data, streamline reporting processes, and provide clear visibility into project costs, forecasts, commitments, and variances. Responsibilities Consolidate project cost data from various sources into standardized reports. Collaborate with project managers, cost engineers, planners, and schedulers to enhance project data flow. Streamline reporting processes to ensure clarity and precision. Provide detailed visibility into project costs, forecasts, commitments, and variances. Support risk and change management efforts. Drive improvements in the handling and reporting of cost information. Essential Skills Proficiency in cost control and cost analysis. Experience with forecasting and analyzing cost variances. Ability to align cost structures with execution plans. Strong data integration skills. Knowledge of EcoSys, Power BI, and Primavera 6. Additional Skills & Qualifications Experience in developing cost forecasts. Capability to improve data integrity. Using integrated systems and data to analyze project performance. Work Environment The work environment involves collaboration with various stakeholders using advanced technologies such as EcoSys, Power BI, and Primavera 6. The role requires attention to detail and strong analytical skills to support capital projects and turnaround activities. Job Type & Location This is a Contract position based out of Wichita, KS. This role will serve as Scrum Master for multiple Agile teams while also driving business analysis activities, stakeholder engagement, and requirements management across cross-functional engineering and product teams. Job Title: Analyst, Quality Control Job Description We are seeking a motivated Quality Control (QC) Analyst to join our dynamic QC Microbiology team. This role offers an opportunity to influence the culture and operations of an early-phase QC group while collaborating across functions in a start-up environment. The position is based in Louisville, CO. Responsibilities Demonstrate company values as part of a high-performing, inclusive, and collaborative organization. Perform routine Quality Control laboratory work, including environmental monitoring, clean utility sampling and testing, microbiological material qualification and maintenance, microbial identification, raw material sampling and inspection, bioburden testing, endotoxin testing, compendial testing, and container closure integrity testing. Follow established Quality Control procedures and maintain proficiency in applicable laboratory methods, systems, and processes. Document laboratory activities in accordance with applicable procedures and cGMP requirements. Apply Operational Excellence/LEAN philosophy within QC laboratories for continuous improvement across all programs, processes, and systems. Prepare, ship, and track samples to outside testing laboratories. Perform additional duties within the Quality organization as required. Essential Skills Bachelors degree in Biochemistry, Molecular and Cellular Biology, Immunology, Biology, or other life science. 0+ years of experience working in a cGMP regulated QC environment. Passion for teamwork and commitment to purpose, team success, and an outstanding workplace culture. Ability to work on-site 5 days per week and ability to work evenings and/or weekends as needed. Additional Skills & Qualifications Self-motivated with strong time management skills and ability to work independently. Proficient computer skills and experience using MS Office applications and Laboratory Information Management Systems (LIMS). Commitment to continuous learning and development of laboratory expertise. Ability to aseptically gown and work while standing for extended periods in cleanrooms. Ability to regularly lift 20 lbs. and periodically lift up to 50 lbs. Desire for continuous self-development and process improvement. Work Environment The work environment promotes work-life balance with core hours from Monday to Friday, 9 am to 4 pm, and flexibility in scheduling around core hours. One day per month may require a longer shift from 12 pm to 9 pm. The culture is collaborative, emphasizing good communication and proactive work. Integrity and thoughtful work practices are prioritized, ensuring a supportive and innovative workplace. Job Type & Location This is a Contract position based out of Louisville, CO. Pay and Benefits The pay range for this position is $26.92 - $33.17/hr. Job Title: Budget Analyst Clinical Trial Finance Job Description This role focuses on developing, negotiating, and managing industry-sponsored clinical trial budgets within a cancer research environment. You will prepare complex proposals, build and justify project budgets, support both pre-award and post-award activities, and ensure compliance with sponsored research guidelines and institutional policies. The position offers opportunities at both sr and entry levels, allowing you to work closely with clinical research teams, sponsors, and internal stakeholders to support high-impact oncology studies. Responsibilities Prepare complex research proposals in alignment with sponsored and non-sponsored research guidelines, ensuring accurate and timely submission via paper and electronic systems. Oversee and communicate the proposal submission process to all stakeholders, proactively resolving issues related to proposal preparation and submission. Develop, prepare, revise, and finalize detailed project budgets for clinical trials, including clear budget justifications and documentation of cost-sharing commitments. Serve as a liaison and active partner between principal investigators, the Office of Sponsored Research, clinical research groups, and other departments to facilitate smooth budget and award processes. Respond to sponsor inquiries related to budgets and financial terms, and advise stakeholders of new regulations and sponsor requirements. Collaborate with the Office of Sponsored Research to ensure awards are set up correctly, cost-sharing requirements are fulfilled, and cost transfers are initiated as needed. Review and approve expenditures on assigned projects, advise on post-award spending and commitment activity, and oversee compliance related to funds and revenue. Develop and communicate reports that clearly present project financial status, including creating forecasting models, scenarios, and decision aids to support decision-making. Manage contract closeout processes and respond to audit inquiries, ensuring submission of accurate and complete final reports and certificates. Interpret complex university and government policies, including FAR, Cost Accounting Standards, Office of Management and Budget circulars, and sponsored guidelines, and guide project and university personnel in their application. Identify and implement process improvements in budgeting and sponsored research workflows, and participate in or lead cross-campus projects to enhance efficiency and compliance. Train and advise colleagues on issues requiring specific technical expertise in budgeting, clinical trial finance, and sponsored research administration. Oversee and review the work of other staff involved in budgeting and financial analysis; may supervise, train, and mentor team members as appropriate. Job Title: Industrial Engineering Analytics Engineer Location: Austin, TX Job Description The Industrial Engineering Analytics Engineer leads the development and application of advanced analytical models to improve manufacturing efficiency, capacity planning, and cost optimization in large-scale production environments. This role builds and manages integrated industrial engineering models that connect capacity, labor, material flow, and cost of goods sold to enable data-driven decision-making across factory and site operations. The position combines strong industrial engineering fundamentals with advanced analytics, simulation, business case development, and AI-driven systems to support both tactical and strategic manufacturing decisions. Responsibilities Develop and own integrated industrial engineering models that connect capacity, labor, material flow, and cost of goods sold to support factory planning and operations. Build and maintain capacity models that compare target, forecast, and gated capacity, incorporating cycle time, overall equipment effectiveness (OEE), yield losses, and bottleneck analysis. Develop labor models to optimize headcount, utilization, and labor cost across production systems. Create and evaluate business cases for capital investments, including ROI, IRR, NPV, and detailed cost-benefit analysis. Lead cost of goods sold (COGS) modeling, including labor, overhead, scrap, and process-driven cost components. Develop and track scrap and yield models, quantify cost impact, and identify opportunities for improvement. Design and maintain OEE models that capture availability, performance, and quality to drive operational efficiency and continuous improvement. Support factory layout, site planning, and material flow decisions through data-driven insights and modeling. Perform scenario analysis and sensitivity studies to evaluate production strategies and capacity expansion plans. Utilize and develop factory simulation models (such as FlexSim, AnyLogic, and similar tools) to analyze throughput, bottlenecks, and overall system performance. Support factory ramp-up, equipment installation, and operational readiness through model validation and performance tracking. Collaborate with manufacturing, operations, supply chain, finance, and engineering teams to align models with real-world constraints and business needs. Translate complex analytical outputs into clear, executive-level insights and recommendations for stakeholders. Work closely with MES and controls teams to integrate shop-floor data with industrial engineering models, ensuring accurate OEE measurement and enabling real-time, scalable dashboards for operational visibility and executive decision-making. Introduce and implement AI-driven tools and platforms to enhance industrial engineering analytics and decision-making. Job Title: Quality Control Analyst Job Description The Quality Control Analyst will perform routine and non-routine laboratory testing on raw materials, in-process samples, and finished products to ensure compliance with quality specifications. This role is vital in maintaining the integrity and safety of products through meticulous testing and documentation. Responsibilities Conduct routine and non-routine laboratory testing on raw materials, in-process samples, and finished products. Perform Ph and moisture testing, density measurements, chemical titrations, and allergen testing. Monitor critical control points and support food safety programs. Review and document test results, investigate out-of-specification findings, and support root cause analysis and corrective actions. Collaborate with production and operations teams to ensure quality standards are maintained throughout the manufacturing process. Maintain accurate and compliant documentation in accordance with company policies and regulatory requirements. Assist with internal and external audits, including customer, regulatory, and third-party inspections. Support continuous improvement initiatives related to product quality, food safety, and process efficiency. Calibrate and maintain laboratory equipment to ensure accuracy and reliability of results. Participate in training programs to promote quality awareness and compliance across the facility. Essential Skills Proficiency in quality assurance and quality control practices. Experience in a laboratory environment. Knowledge of FDA and USDA regulations. Ability to conduct various laboratory tests such as Ph, moisture testing, density measurements, and chemical titrations. Additional Skills & Qualifications Bachelors degree in Food Science, Microbiology, Chemistry, or a related scientific field is preferred but not required. Work Environment This role operates in both laboratory and manufacturing environments, requiring work around food processing equipment and varying temperatures. The position follows an overnight shift with a 2/2/3 schedule from 6PM-6AM. Job Type & Location This is a Contract to Hire position based out of South Sioux City, NE. Pay and Benefits The pay range for this position is $22.00 - $25.00/hr. Job Title: Senior Analyst, Quality Assurance Job Description The Senior Analyst, Quality Assurance will join a dynamic Quality Assurance team as a contractor, with primary responsibility for document control and training activities and the potential to support additional QA functions as needed. This role works cross-functionally to ensure robust quality systems, accurate documentation, and effective training programs that support a regulated biopharmaceutical environment. Responsibilities Work effectively and collaboratively across multiple functional areas to fulfill Quality Assurance document control and training responsibilities. Provide administrative support in Learning Management and Document Management Systems, including data entry, record maintenance, and system updates as needed. Support the controlled document revision process by performing Quality Assurance Document Control (QADC) review in the electronic document management system. Maintain, organize, and control the document room and other document storage areas to ensure secure and compliant document handling. Issue, reconcile, and store controlled documents and logbooks, ensuring accurate tracking and traceability in accordance with good documentation practices. Organize, facilitate, and execute the archival process for controlled documents when required, ensuring proper long-term storage and retrieval. Support the training program by creating training content as needed, organizing and structuring training assignments, and processing new training requests. Review and approve Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and other controlled documents in alignment with quality and regulatory requirements, as applicable. Provide additional support within the Quality organization, including assistance with corrections, GDP compliance, new hire training, and quality-related training activities. Collaborate cross-functionally with operations, quality control, and other teams to support batch record review, QC test form management, and document control review. Work within electronic quality and document systems such as Veeva, and leverage experience with similar platforms like MasterControl and TrackWise to manage documentation and training records. Print documents, create and manage document issuance, receiving, and reconciliation in the system, and perform thorough review of every document for document control compliance. Support organizations outside of Quality when needed, providing quality-focused guidance on documentation, training, and compliance. Adhere to and promote Good Documentation Practices (GDP), Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), and relevant quality standards in all activities. Follow SOPs and quality procedures rigorously while demonstrating initiative and the ability to reprioritize tasks in a fast-paced, changing environment. Essential Skills Bachelors degree in Engineering, Biochemistry, Molecular and Cellular Biology, Immunology, Biology, or another life science discipline.

Job Title: Structural Dynamics Analyst Job Description We are seeking a Structural Dynamics Analyst to support the design, analysis, verification, and qualification of advanced aerospace systems. This role involves performing structural dynamics assessments, developing finite element models, and evaluating hardware performance throughout the product development lifecycle. The ideal candidate will collaborate closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams to ensure structural integrity, dynamic performance, and compliance with program requirements. Responsibilities Perform structural dynamics assessments for aerospace systems. Develop finite element models to evaluate hardware performance. Conduct loads, vibration, shock, acoustic, and modal analyses. Support hardware test campaigns and correlate analytical models to test data. Ensure compliance with aerospace industry standards and requirements. Present technical findings to multidisciplinary teams. Essential Skills Bachelors degree in Mechanical Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or a related engineering discipline from an accredited institution. Minimum of 5 years of experience performing structural dynamics analyses for aerospace, spaceflight, or other complex engineered systems. Proficiency with engineering analysis tools such as MATLAB, Python, or similar software packages. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Additional Skills & Qualifications Experience supporting spacecraft, launch vehicle, satellite, or human spaceflight programs. Proficiency with Beta CAE software products, including ANSA, META, and EPILYSIS. Experience working within Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) environments such as Windchill. Demonstrated project leadership, task management, or technical lead experience. Work Environment The candidate will be working in an environment split between 80% office work and 20% shop interaction with technicians. Job Title: Systems Engineer / Analyst Job Description This role focuses on implementing integrated system performance analysis metrics and transforming complex test data into meaningful insights that inform system-level decisions. You will develop Python and SQL-based tools for data analysis, contribute to the organization and interpretation of test data, and support systems engineering activities in an aerospace context. The position requires strong technical skills, analytical thinking, and the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-disciplinary teams. Responsibilities Implement integrated system performance analysis metrics to evaluate and improve overall system behavior. Contribute to the management, organization, and analysis of test data to generate system-level metrics and performance indicators. Develop Python-based tooling and scripts to support data analysis and reporting for systems engineering activities. Utilize SQL to query, manage, and transform data sets used in system performance evaluations. Perform data analysis to support systems engineering decisions, including interpreting trends, anomalies, and performance outcomes. Collaborate with cross-disciplinary teams and communicate technical findings clearly to stakeholders from different engineering backgrounds. Support requirements and verification activities by providing data-driven insights and metrics when applicable. Contribute to system-level analyses such as power balance and power budget assessments, mass analysis, consumables analysis, thermal analysis, and power systems analysis as needed. Act as the primary onsite expert for integrated system performance analysis, owning the development and maintenance of analysis tools and methodologies. Essential Skills Proven experience with Python for data analysis and the development of tooling to support engineering and test data evaluation. Strong proficiency in SQL for querying, managing, and analyzing structured data. Hands-on experience in systems engineering, with the ability to apply analytical methods to complex technical systems. Ability to work effectively with cross-disciplinary teams and communicate technical information clearly and professionally. Demonstrated capability to manage, organize, and interpret test data to produce meaningful system performance metrics. Additional Skills & Qualifications Aerospace engineering or closely related engineering disciplines. Human spaceflight experience, including familiarity with spaceflight systems and operational constraints. Experience with requirements definition, requirements management, and verification processes. Knowledge of power balance and power budget analysis for complex systems. Experience performing mass analysis and consumables analysis for system-level designs. Familiarity with thermal analysis and power systems analysis in an engineering environment. Job Type & Location This is a Permanent position based out of Houston, TX. Job Title: Thermal Engineer Job Description The Thermal Engineer will support the design, development, analysis, and verification of advanced aerospace systems with a primary focus on thermal performance. In this role, you develop thermal models, perform detailed thermal analyses, and support thermal testing activities throughout the product lifecycle. You work closely with multidisciplinary engineering teams to ensure thermal designs meet mission requirements, performance objectives, and industry best practices. Responsibilities Develop, maintain, and validate thermal models ranging from simplified representations to high-fidelity simulations using Thermal Desktop, SINDA/FLUINT, and related analysis tools. Perform steady-state and transient thermal analyses for components, subsystems, and integrated vehicle configurations to predict and optimize thermal performance. Evaluate thermal behavior across multiple mission phases, including launch, ascent, cruise, orbital operations, surface operations, and off-nominal scenarios. Conduct thermal sensitivity studies to support design evaluations, hardware development efforts, and engineering requirements definition. Support thermal verification and validation activities, including test planning, thermal vacuum testing, data analysis, and correlation of test results with analytical models. Collaborate with cross-functional engineering teams to optimize passive and active thermal control system architectures for aerospace applications. Provide technical guidance on thermal design considerations and ensure compliance with program requirements, engineering standards, and industry best practices. Participate in design reviews, technical interchange meetings, trade studies, and anomaly investigations, contributing thermal analysis expertise and recommendations. Review internal and external thermal designs for technical accuracy, performance, and compliance with engineering requirements and mission objectives. Prepare clear technical reports, engineering analyses, presentations, and documentation to communicate findings, results, and recommendations to stakeholders. Support integration efforts with systems engineering, mission operations, and hardware development teams throughout the engineering lifecycle. Engage with project teams over time with the potential opportunity to transition to a direct role with the client after a contract-to-hire period. Essential Skills At least 4 years of experience working as a Thermal Engineer in aerospace or a closely related field. Strong proficiency in thermal analysis and thermal design for aerospace systems and components. Hands-on experience with thermal analysis tools such as Thermal Desktop, COMSOL, and ANSYS Fluent. Proficiency with SINDA/FLUINT or similar thermal network analysis tools. Solid understanding of heat transfer principles, including conduction, convection, and radiation. We are seeking a data-driven Business Analyst to design and optimize customer support, teleoperations, and remote assistance workflows for our autonomous taxi (robotaxi) fleet. In this role, you will act as the bridge between autonomous vehicle operations and rider support. While you will not be performing raw point-cloud or sensor signal processing, you must bring a solid conceptual understanding of the autonomous stack—including ADAS, LiDAR, radar, and camera perception—to accurately translate vehicle events into real-time agent workflows. You will pair this domain literacy with strong SQL, Python, and modern dashboarding skills, alongside hands-on application of GenAI and GenBI, to automate customer interactions and drive fleet performance insights. Please note that this role is fully onsite in Plano, TX . Translate vehicle health, perception status flags (LiDAR/radar/camera health indicators), and ADAS state transitions into clear operational triggers for the support team. Define and track mission-critical metrics: Time-to-Intervene (TTI), Mean Time to Resolve (MTTR), First Contact Resolution (FCR), and Rider Safety NPS. Use Python (Pandas, NumPy) for exploratory data analysis, pattern identification in incident data, and automated reporting scripts. Design, build, and maintain production-grade operational dashboards using Power BI, Tableau, or QuickSight to deliver real-time operational visibility to executive and operations teams. Support the rollout of GenBI tools (e.g., Power BI Copilot, ThoughtSpot, Amazon Q) to enable operations stakeholders to query fleet and support data using natural language. Collaborate with AI engineers to design safety guardrails, prompt templates, and evaluation criteria for customer-facing conversational agents inside the vehicle. Partner with Teleoperations Leads, Fleet Operations, Data Engineers, and CCaaS engineering teams to deliver iterative platform upgrades. Job Summary Serve as a business analyst specializing in payment products and automatic payment workflows translating complex business needs into clear functional solutions that optimize hybrid day shift operations while collaborating across global teams. Apply deep Spanish language fluency to support stakeholders refine payment processes and enhance secure transaction experiences for customers and society. Responsibilities Analyze current automatic payment processes and payment product functionalities to identify gaps inefficiencies and opportunities for continuous improvement that enhance operational reliability and customer trust in transactions. Document detailed business requirements for payment product features by engaging with stakeholders across business and technology teams and ensuring that specifications are precise and aligned with regulatory and compliance expectations. Collaborate with product owners and technical teams to validate functional payment solutions and ensure that designed workflows for automatic payments are efficient scalable and user centric for a diverse customer base. Translate complex payment product concepts and rules into clear user stories acceptance criteria and process maps that guide development activities and support transparent communication among multilingual stakeholders. Perform detailed impact analysis for proposed changes to automatic payment systems and payment product configurations to minimize risk and safeguard the stability of transaction processing environments. Coordinate and execute functional testing for payment products including regression and integration testing to verify that automatic payment features operate correctly across upstream and downstream systems. Develop and maintain documentation for payment product functionalities including process flows configuration details and reference guides that support cross functional teams in hybrid work settings. Engage with operations and support teams to analyze incident trends in payment processing and propose targeted enhancements that reduce failure rates and improve customer experience outcomes. Use Spanish native language skills to facilitate workshops requirement gathering sessions and status communications with Spanish speaking stakeholders thereby improving clarity and alignment on payment product initiatives. Monitor key performance indicators related to automatic payment success rates processing times and exception volumes and produce analytical reports that inform data driven decisions for product refinement. Support risk and compliance reviews by explaining business logic behind payment product functionalities and documenting controls that contribute to secure and ethically responsible financial transactions. Collaborate in a hybrid work model by effectively managing virtual and onsite interactions and maintaining consistent communication practices that keep cross regional teams informed on project progress. Job summary Sr Business Analyst role focused on analyzing complex business processes translating stakeholder needs into clear requirements and driving impactful solutions that align with organizational strategy. The role involves hybrid work with day shifts collaborating across teams to improve performance optimize operations and enable data informed decisions while ensuring consistent delivery quality and sustainable value. Responsibilities Analyze diverse business processes and stakeholder objectives to identify improvement opportunities that enhance operational efficiency and support strategic organizational goals. Collaborate with cross functional teams to gather detailed business requirements and translate them into clear functional specifications that guide solution design and implementation. Document current and future state workflows with precise process maps and narratives that help stakeholders understand impacts dependencies and required changes. Evaluate potential solution options using structured analysis techniques and recommend approaches that balance business value feasibility and long term sustainability. Facilitate requirement walkthroughs and feedback sessions with stakeholders to confirm shared understanding resolve ambiguities and secure alignment on scope and priorities. Support development and configuration activities by clarifying requirements answering business context questions and validating proposed technical designs against business needs. Design comprehensive test scenarios and acceptance criteria that verify end to end coverage of requirements and enable robust user acceptance testing outcomes. Analyze data and performance metrics from implemented solutions to measure value realization identify gaps or issues and propose improvements that refine business outcomes. Prepare clear status reports and analytic summaries that communicate progress risks and insights to stakeholders in a concise and actionable format. Coordinate hybrid working interactions by planning onsite and remote collaboration sessions that maintain productivity inclusiveness and timely decision making. Ensure compliance with internal standards and industry regulations in all analysis deliverables so that solutions are secure ethical and aligned to societal expectations. Contribute to knowledge sharing by creating reusable templates guidelines and best practice documentation that strengthen the business analysis capability across the company. Partner with business and technology teams to ensure that implemented solutions improve customer and employee experiences and positively impact broader communities. Qualifications Apply deep business analysis expertise gained from eight to ten years of experience to interpret complex stakeholder needs and convert them into structured requirements. Demonstrate strong proficiency in business analysis practices and business analysis and planning disciplines such as process modeling requirements elicitation and impac

About Cognizant Workday Cognizant Workday practice is recruiting for upcoming graduates who are looking for an exciting, entry level consulting opportunity starting in the summer of 2027. We proudly partner with Workday, one of the leading cloud-based software solutions for HR, finance and payroll management. About the role As a Workday Data Conversion Analyst, you will make an impact by helping customers get the most out of their Workday implementations as part of a dynamic transformation consulting project team. You will be a valued member of the Cognizant Workday practice team and work collaboratively with lead consultants, project managers, Engagement Managers, experienced Workday implementation professionals, and clients. In this role, you will Complete training and earn a Workday certification Participate in Workday implementation activities related to data conversion, including discovery, design, configuration, documentation, testing, and project review sessions. Learn to use Workday data conversion tools such as iLoad, EIBs, Object Transporter, and Advanced Load to perform tenant-to-tenant migrations. Learn the basics of the Workday product to effectively validate data, troubleshoot issues, and support your project team. Frequently update your project lead, manager, and Engagement Manager on timelines, tasks, risks, responsibilities, tenant management, and data conversion. Stay current on Workday updates and project changes, and proactively seek opportunities to grow your skills. Work model At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible, and we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs. Based on this role's business requirements, this is an onsite position requiring 5 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Plano, TX. The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations. What you must have to be considered Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, MIS, or a related field. Strong Excel competency, including formulas, pivot tables, and ASAP Utilities. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Strong communication and presentation skills, with the ability to effectively manage customer expectations. Ability to work well individually and in a team environment, with willingness to travel to customer sites when needed. These will help you succeed Knowledge of Workday. We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

Our client, manufacturing operations is seeking a Manufacturing Cost Analyst to join their team. As a Manufacturing Cost Analyst, you will be part of the cost and estimating function supporting job costing and material planning. The ideal candidate will have strong attention to detail, a practical understanding of pricing and materials, and the drive to deliver accurate quotes that help teams complete jobs efficiently. Job Title: Manufacturing Cost Analyst Location: Somerset, PA Pay Range: $20-22/hour based on experience Shift: Monday - Friday 7a-3:30, with additional options of 4:30 or 5:30; Saturdays 7a-11 or 12 (OT is available and encouraged) What's the Job? Ensure best pricing options for materials needed to complete jobs. Get material quotes to cost jobs out accurately and efficiently. Support job costing decisions by comparing quote options and identifying cost-effective materials. Coordinate quote requests and follow up to keep estimating timelines on track. Contribute to accurate, job-ready cost information for internal teams. What's Needed? Ability to work Monday through Friday with Saturday availability as scheduled. Comfort working in a manufacturing environment and handling job-related materials and documentation. Strong attention to detail to support accurate quoting and job costing. Professional communication skills to request and confirm material quotes. Willingness to complete required screening: oral drug test (6-panel) and a local criminal background check. What's in it for me? Opportunity to step into a role focused on pricing, materials, and job costing impact. Clear schedule with Monday–Friday hours and optional/available overtime on Saturdays. Job Summary This role focuses on designing and optimizing robust data platforms using Apache Iceberg for a hi tech environment ensuring reliable data ingestion storage and access for analytics teams. The professional will work from office in a day shift collaborating with product and engineering partners to deliver scalable data solutions that improve decision making and support innovative digital services for global stakeholders. Responsibilities Design and implement highly scalable data lake and warehouse solutions using Apache Iceberg to support complex analytics and reporting needs in a hi tech product ecosystem. Develop efficient batch and streaming data pipelines that ensure accurate ingestion transformation and partitioning of large data volumes while maintaining strong data quality standards. Optimize data storage layouts file formats and metadata management within Apache Iceberg environments to achieve improved query performance and resource utilization. Collaborate closely with product managers data analysts and software engineers to translate business requirements into well structured data models and reliable data services. Establish robust data governance practices including schema evolution strategies data retention rules and catalog management to maintain consistent and compliant datasets. Implement monitoring and alerting for data workflows by configuring metrics logs and health checks that proactively identify data integrity or performance issues. Create clear technical documentation covering data architecture diagrams pipeline specifications and operational procedures to support knowledge sharing and smooth onboarding. Support performance tuning activities by analyzing query patterns optimizing joins and aggregations and refining clustering strategies within the data platform. Coordinate with security and compliance teams to embed access controls encryption mechanisms and audit trails that protect sensitive information in line with hi tech industry expectations. Provide guidance to stakeholders on using curated datasets and semantic layers effectively so that analytics outcomes directly contribute to product innovation and customer experience improvements. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by evaluating emerging data technologies compatible with Apache Iceberg and proposing practical enhancements to the existing stack. Engage in cross functional discussions to ensure data solutions align with organizational objectives and create positive impact on digital services offered to society. Participate in on site collaboration sessions during regular day shifts to resolve data issues quickly and maintain high availability of critical analytical datasets. Qualifications Bring strong hands on experience working with Apache Iceberg in production environments including design of tables partitions and snapshot management for reliable data storage. Demonstrate solid knowledge of data engineering concepts such as ETL development

Responsibilities Design and implement highly scalable data lake and warehouse solutions using Apache Iceberg to support complex analytics and reporting needs in a hi tech product ecosystem. Develop efficient batch and streaming data pipelines that ensure accurate ingestion transformation and partitioning of large data volumes while maintaining strong data quality standards. Optimize data storage layouts file formats and metadata management within Apache Iceberg environments to achieve improved query performance and resource utilization. Collaborate closely with product managers data analysts and software engineers to translate business requirements into well structured data models and reliable data services. Establish robust data governance practices including schema evolution strategies data retention rules and catalog management to maintain consistent and compliant datasets. Implement monitoring and alerting for data workflows by configuring metrics logs and health checks that proactively identify data integrity or performance issues. Create clear technical documentation covering data architecture diagrams pipeline specifications and operational procedures to support knowledge sharing and smooth onboarding. Support performance tuning activities by analyzing query patterns optimizing joins and aggregations and refining clustering strategies within the data platform. Coordinate with security and compliance teams to embed access controls encryption mechanisms and audit trails that protect sensitive information in line with hi tech industry expectations. Provide guidance to stakeholders on using curated datasets and semantic layers effectively so that analytics outcomes directly contribute to product innovation and customer experience improvements. Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by evaluating emerging data technologies compatible with Apache Iceberg and proposing practical enhancements to the existing stack. Engage in cross functional discussions to ensure data solutions align with organizational objectives and create positive impact on digital services offered to society. Participate in on site collaboration sessions during regular day shifts to resolve data issues quickly and maintain high availability of critical analytical datasets. Qualifications Bring strong hands on experience working with Apache Iceberg in production environments including design of tables partitions and snapshot management for reliable data storage. Demonstrate solid knowledge of data engineering concepts such as ETL development

Title: AWS Data Engineer Location: Singapore Key Responsibilities Design, build, and operate end-to-end data pipelines (ingestion → transformation → serving) on Databricks and/or Snowflake, following medallion/layered architecture patterns Configure and administer workspaces/accounts — compute policies, resource sizing, environment setup, and access hierarchy — per the SDP reference architecture Implement data governance controls: catalogue and schema design, RBAC, row/column-level security, data masking, and lineage tracking Set up CI/CD and infrastructure-as-code for pipeline deployment and environment promotion (dev → test → prod) Configure monitoring, telemetry, and audit logging to meet SDP's central observability and security posture requirements Support UAT, integration testing, and parallel-run validation during migration and go-live Produce handover documentation (runbooks, access lists, escalation procedures) for agency operations teams Required Technical Skills — Databricks Unity Catalog — catalogue/schema design, access control, and data lineage Lakeflow / Delta Live Tables for pipeline orchestration; Delta Lake table format Databricks SQL and cluster/workspace administration (compute policies, pools, cost management) Databricks Asset Bundles (DABs) and Databricks Repos for CI/CD PySpark / Spark SQL for large-scale data transformation Working knowledge of Databricks system tables (audit logs, billing/usage, query history) for observability Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in Data Engineering, Data Platform Engineering, or related disciplines. Minimum 3 years of hands-on experience with Databricks involving data pipeline development, platform administration, governance, and optimization. Required Technical Skills — Common Strong SQL and Python (PySpark or general-purpose) for data engineering Data modeling — dimensional design, star/snowflake schemas, semantic layers CI/CD pipelines (e.g., Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI) for data engineering workflows Infrastructure-as-code (Terraform preferred) for provisioning cloud data platform resources Hands-on experience on at least one hyperscaler — AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Understanding of data security and compliance frameworks Preferred Qualifications Databricks Certified Data Engineer Associate/Professional SnowPro Core, or SnowPro Advanced: Data Engineer AWS certification (e.g. AWS Certified Data Engineer - Associate, Solutions Architect) and hands-on experience with AWS data services. Prior experience delivering on a regulated-sector data platform, or exposure to compliance frameworks such as IM8, is an add-on Experience working as part of a System Integrator (SI) delivery team alongside a platform Principal is an add-on #LI-CTSAPAC

job_title: Data Engineer – Snowflake / Apache Iceberg / Python
description: Job Responsibilities Design, develop, and implement scalable data engineering solutions to support PIPL program requirements. Build and maintain end-to-end ETL/ELT pipelines using Python, SQL, and modern data engineering frameworks. Develop and manage data lakehouse architectures using Apache Iceberg and Snowflake. Create and support a dedicated China data environment on Alibaba Cloud (AliCloud) for data processing, analytics, machine learning, and reporting workloads. Automate data ingestion, transformation, validation, and reporting processes to improve operational efficiency. Optimize data pipelines, storage, and query performance to ensure scalability and reliability. Collaborate with architects, program leads, and business stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver data solutions. Ensure data quality, governance, security, and compliance with PIPL and enterprise standards. Monitor, troubleshoot, and resolve data platform and pipeline issues. Contribute to best practices in DataOps, CI/CD, automation, and cloud-native data engineering. Job Requirements 5+ years of experience in Data Engineering, Data Warehousing, or Big Data environments. Strong hands-on experience with Apache Iceberg. Proven experience working with Snowflake for data warehousing and analytics. Advanced proficiency in Python and SQL development. Experience designing and building ETL/ELT pipelines and data integration solutions. Solid understanding of data lake, lakehouse, and data warehouse architectures. Experience working with cloud platforms, preferably Alibaba Cloud (AliCloud). Knowledge of distributed data processing technologies such as Apache Spark, Flink, or similar frameworks. Experience with data modeling, performance tuning, and data quality management. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Git, and automation tools. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills. Experience in regulatory or data privacy-focused environments (PIPL/GDPR) is an added advantage. #LI-CTSAPAC

job_title: Data Quality Engineer - Remote in Canada
location: Halifax,NS-6940 Mumford Rd, Nova Scotia, Canada
description: Data Quality Engineer As a Data Quality Engineer specializing in Tricentis Tosca Data Integrity at Cognizant, you will design and execute automated data validation across extract, transform, and load (ETL) processes, data warehouses, and data migrations. You will work with development and data engineering teams to verify data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and transformation rules across source and target systems. This is a full-time, remote role open only to candidates located in Canada. In this role, you will Review business requirements, source-to-target mappings, and ETL designs to identify test scenarios and prepare test plans and cases. Design and execute ETL, data warehouse, and data migration tests, including automated data validation scripts using Tosca Data Integrity. Validate data accuracy, completeness, consistency, and transformation rules across source systems, staging layers, and target databases. Perform source-to-target reconciliation and data integrity checks, using SQL queries to validate transformations and load processes. Log, track, and retest defects in partnership with development and data engineering teams. Collaborate with onshore and offshore teams to deliver testing activities and prepare test execution reports and knowledge-transfer documentation. Provide regular status updates, identify risks, and support production validation activities. What you need to have to be considered 6+ years of overall experience in software testing, ETL testing, and data validation, including 3+ years of hands-on experience with Tricentis Tosca Data Integrity. Strong experience in ETL, data warehouse, and data migration testing, including validation across source systems, staging layers, and target databases. Hands-on SQL query writing and database testing experience with relational databases such as SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, or DB2. Strong understanding of ETL processes, data transformations, source-to-target mapping, data reconciliation, and data integrity testing. Ability to analyze business requirements, data models, mapping documents, and technical specifications and translate them into test plans and test cases. Experience with test execution and defect management using tools such as JIRA, Azure DevOps, or ALM. Experience in Agile/Scrum environments and an onshore-offshore delivery model, with effective cross-functional collaboration. Strong analytical, root-cause analysis, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills, with clear verbal and written communication. These will help you stand out Insurance domain experience. Experience with cloud data platforms such as Azure, AWS, or Snowflake. Knowledge of data lake and big data testing. Experience with Informatica, DataStage, SSIS, Talend, or other ETL tools. Tosca Automation Certification. Why Apply? We’re excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don’t hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed.

FACETS & NetworX Configuration Analyst Location: Remote Employment Type: Full-Time Remote - United States Job ID: 00071022791 FACETS & NetworX Configuration Analyst About the role As a FACETS & NetworX Configuration Analyst , you will support healthcare benefits and pricing configuration activities within FACETS and NetworX. You will work collaboratively with business, configuration, and testing teams to translate benefit requirements into system configuration, validate claim outcomes, and help resolve benefit and pricing-related issues. In this role, you will: Support FACETS Benefits Configuration based on business and benefit requirements, including copays, coinsurance, deductibles, benefit limits, and in-network/out-of-network benefits. Assist with NetworX pricing configuration and related validation activities. Perform configuration testing and validate expected healthcare claim outcomes. Support SIT/UAT testing, defect analysis, and resolution related to benefits and pricing configuration. Partner with senior team members, business stakeholders, and testing teams to implement configuration changes and maintain accurate documentation. Work model We strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role’s business requirements, this is a remote position open to qualified applicants in the United States . Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs. The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you’re engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured, we will always be clear about role expectations. What you need to have to be considered 3 years of experience in healthcare, healthcare IT, claims processing, benefits configuration, or a related area. Basic understanding of or exposure to FACETS Benefits Configuration. Basic understanding of or exposure to NetworX pricing configuration. Working knowledge of healthcare claims processing and adjudication, including deductibles, copays, coinsurance, and benefit limits. Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and documentation skills, with an ability and willingness to learn FACETS and NetworX configuration. These will help you stand out Hands-on exposure to FACETS benefits configuration in a healthcare payer environment. Exposure to NetworX pricing and provider reimbursement configuration. Experience supporting SIT/UAT testing, claim validation, or defect resolution. Understanding of in-network and out-of-network benefit structures. Experience working collaboratively with healthcare business, configuration, and testing teams. Salary and Other Compensation: Applicants will be accepted till 9/20/2026 Cognizant will only consider applicants for this position who are legally authorized to work in the United States without company sponsorship. *Please note, this role is not able to offer visa transfer or spo

Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work-life balance through our various wellbeing programs. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations. Strong knowledge of LLMs, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector search, retrieval strategies, agent orchestration, and model evaluation. Experience with AWS cloud services, preferably Amazon Bedrock, and cloud-native application architectures. Expertise with APIs, microservices, containers, CI/CD pipelines, DevOps practices, and distributed systems. Strong understanding of AI security, responsible AI, governance, observability, and production monitoring. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to influence technical and business teams. Job summary Sr Business Analyst role focused on analyzing complex business processes translating stakeholder needs into clear requirements and driving impactful solutions that align with organizational strategy. The role involves hybrid work with day shifts collaborating across teams to improve performance optimize operations and enable data informed decisions while ensuring consistent delivery quality and sustainable value. Responsibilities Analyze diverse business processes and stakeholder objectives to identify improvement opportunities that enhance operational efficiency and support strategic organizational goals. Collaborate with cross functional teams to gather detailed business requirements and translate them into clear functional specifications that guide solution design and implementation. Document current and future state workflows with precise process maps and narratives that help stakeholders understand impacts dependencies and required changes. Evaluate potential solution options using structured analysis techniques and recommend approaches that balance business value feasibility and long term sustainability. Facilitate requirement walkthroughs and feedback sessions with stakeholders to confirm shared understanding resolve ambiguities and secure alignment on scope and priorities. Support development and configuration activities by clarifying requirements answering business context questions and validating proposed technical designs against business needs. Design comprehensive test scenarios and acceptance criteria that verify end to end coverage of requirements and enable robust user acceptance testing outcomes. Analyze data and performance metrics from implemented solutions to measure value realization identify gaps or issues and propose improvements that refine business outcomes. Prepare clear status reports and analytic summaries that communicate progress risks and insights to stakeholders in a concise and actionable format. Coordinate hybrid working interactions by planning onsite and remote collaboration sessions that maintain productivity inclusiveness and timely decision making. Ensure compliance with internal standards and industry regulations in all analysis deliverables so that solutions are secure ethical and aligned to societal expectations. Contribute to knowledge sharing by creating reusable templates guidelines and best practice documentation that strengthen the business analysis capability across the company. Partner with business and technology teams to ensure that implemented solutions improve customer and employee experiences and positively impact broader communities. Qualifications Apply deep business analysis expertise gained from eight to ten years of experience to interpret complex stakeholder needs and convert them into structured requirements. Demonstrate strong proficiency in business analysis practices and business analysis and planning disciplines such as process modeling requirements elicitation and impac

Workday Finance Testing Engineer Experience: 6 Yrs to 15 Yrs Location: Bengaluru / Hyderabad / Chennai / Remote Job Summary We are seeking a skilled Workday Finance Testing Engineer to validate and ensure the quality of Workday Financial Management implementations, enhancements, integrations, and upgrades. The ideal candidate should possess strong expertise in Workday Financials modules, test planning, execution, defect management, and end-to-end business process validation. Key Responsibilities Analyze business requirements, functional specifications, and Workday Finance configurations. Design, develop, and execute test scenarios, test cases, and test scripts for Workday Financial Management modules. Perform functional, integration, regression, system, and user acceptance testing (UAT). Validate configurations across Workday Finance modules including: Financial Accounting Accounts Payable (AP) Accounts Receivable (AR) Procurement Expense Management Revenue Management Asset Management Banking & Settlement Financial Reporting Test inbound and outbound integrations between Workday and external financial systems. Verify data migration and data reconciliation activities. Execute end-to-end business process testing and financial workflow validations. Log, track, and manage defects using tools such as Jira, Azure DevOps, or ALM. Collaborate with business stakeholders, functional consultants, developers, and integration teams. Support Workday releases, upgrades, and production validation activities. Prepare test execution reports and quality metrics. Required Skills Workday Functional Skills Strong understanding of Workday Financial Management modules. Experience in testing Workday Finance implementations or support projects. Knowledge of Workday business processes and security configurations. Understanding of financial accounting principles and ERP processes. Testing Skills Functional Testing System Integration Testing (SIT) Regression Testing User Acceptance Testing (UAT) End-to-End Testing Defect Management Test Planning & Execution #LI-SN3
